focal_entities.receiver: someone who builds or changes rn, coming from its README

goal_orientation.use: to know how rn should be built before changing any part of it

goal_orientation.acceptance: they can build or change rn and secure its quality without hesitating, following the design

constraints.rule: Say each of rn's own words in the sentence where it is first used, inside the template's sections, or in the figure's box of the part it belongs to; put no list of words ahead of Goals, and say no word the README already gives again, since the reader comes from the README and takes a list ahead of the content as something to skip.
